## **Rewarding original creators on Instagram**

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=703721394001347&version=1785324458) April 30, 2026

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=1562412312071985&version=1783020750&transcode_extension=webp)

Today, we’re updating how we reward original content. The same protections we introduced to reels in [2024](https://creators.instagram.com/blog/recommendations-and-originality) will now apply to photos and carousels. This means content aggregators who primarily re-upload others' work in photos and carousel posts will no longer be eligible for recommendations across Instagram.

Original creators are the heart of Instagram. Whether you're an artist sharing your perspective or a creator documenting your life through carousels, you deserve credit for the content you make. That's why we've continued to invest in tools and systems to ensure original content gets the credit and distribution it deserves. In fact, original content on Instagram continues to grow, with 75% of recommendations in the US now coming from original posts.

#### **How we’re expanding protections**

We are extending our originality guidelines to include photos and carousels to further discourage aggregators across Instagram. Now, **accounts that primarily post unoriginal content in photos or carousel posts, in addition to reels, will no longer be shown in places where we recommend content**.

**This update does not impact how we show people content from accounts they follow.** It is also separate from our [intellectual property policies](https://creators.instagram.com/micro_site/url/?click_creative_path[0]=link&click_from_context_menu=true&country=US&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.instagram.com%2F535503073130320&event_type=click&last_nav_impression_id=1VvHMZNJe3zJ1AoZX&max_percent_page_viewed=62&max_viewport_height_px=913&max_viewport_width_px=1488&orig_http_referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F&orig_request_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog%2Frecommendations-and-originality&primary_cmsid=1187674242148753&primary_content_locale=en_US&region=noam&scrolled=true&session_id=0a5sNyHB86xKQFcaK&site=igc), which do not allow posting content that violates another user’s intellectual property rights. As a reminder, you are responsible for obtaining any necessary permissions before using someone else’s work.

Aggregator accounts that have become ineligible for recommendations can become eligible again when most of their recently posted photos, carousels, and reels are considered original in a 30-day period. This is calculated on a rolling basis, and accounts can always check their standing in [Account Status](https://creators.instagram.com/micro_site/url/?click_creative_path[0]=link&click_from_context_menu=true&country=US&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fabout.instagram.com%2Fblog%2Fannouncements%2Finstagram-outages-and-account-status&event_type=click&last_nav_impression_id=0GnZ1yrsSF0uAQUFR&max_percent_page_viewed=62&max_viewport_height_px=913&max_viewport_width_px=1488&orig_http_referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F&orig_request_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog%2Frecommendations-and-originality&primary_cmsid=1187674242148753&primary_content_locale=en_US&region=noam&scrolled=false&session_id=1y84qkMXafDt9hpPx&site=igc). There, they have the option to remove unoriginal content or appeal the decision.

#### **Understanding our originality policy**

Original content is work that you wholly created or reflects your unique perspective. Here are some examples:

- **Photos or videos you took** — your photography and edits are reflective of your creative vision.
- **Content you designed**— whether it's a photo series, a how-to guide, or a visual story, if it’s something you personally created, it's your original content.
- **Content you materially edited**— material edits to third-party content (e.g. meme templates, popular clips, etc.) may be considered "original" when your additions meaningfully enhance the content you're using. Some examples include adding unique text on the content itself that provides more context than just describing what’s happening, adding creative graphics that offer new information, or using our remix feature to transform the original.

To assess if the edits you’ve made are sufficient under our originality policy, ask yourself if they add real value beyond just simply restating or referencing the third-party content. If you’re adding new information, context, or a point of view not obvious from the original third-party content, you’re likely on the right track.

What doesn't qualify? Re-uploading someone else's work in a photo, carousel, or reel without adding meaningful creative input to enhance the original, such as just adding a border, watermark, subtitles, or a credit in the captions. To learn more and review specific examples, we highly recommend reviewing our [original content guidelines](http://creators.instagram.com/original-content-guidelines) and [Help Center](https://help.instagram.com/1800814370401535/).

#### **Tips to follow our originality guidelines**

If you regularly publish posts and reels that feature third-party content, follow these additional tips to prevent your content from being categorized as unoriginal:

- **Use our collaboration tools.** Features like [collabs](https://help.instagram.com/291200585956732), [remix](https://help.instagram.com/139004934231412/), or the [paid partnership label](https://help.instagram.com/1109894795810258) for branded content make it easy to include potential third-party content in posts you had a role in creating while ensuring everyone else involved gets credit.
- **Share and curate other people’s content to your audience through existing tools**. If you want to shine a spotlight on third-party content you find interesting, [share content to your story](https://help.instagram.com/1013375002134043/) or use [reposts](https://help.instagram.com/1743992069496286/). These options easily highlight other people’s work while ensuring the original creator receives attribution.
- **Check Account Status.** Go to [Account Status](https://about.instagram.com/blog/announcements/instagram-outages-and-account-status) in your settings to see if your account has any limits to its reach. If your account is ineligible to appear in recommendations because of these guidelines, you can remove the content in question or appeal our decision.

We are committed to building a platform where originality is celebrated and rewarded, making sure original creators get the visibility they deserve.

## Finding success on reels in 2025
### Achieve your goals, whatever they may be
- **Make the most of recommendations.** Content ranking on Instagram historically favored creators with larger followings. However, last year we announced [updates to our recommendations of reels](https://creators.instagram.com/recommendations-and-originality?locale=en_US). Through this process, creators of all sizes have an equal chance of breaking through and reaching new audiences. One of the most effective ways to grow is to post original content consistently, because now everyone has the potential to reach a massive audience.

## Finding success on reels in 2025

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=703721394001347&version=1785324458) January 21, 2025

In 2024, we introduced improvements to Reels to help creators like you expand your creativity, grow your career, and achieve your goals. This work was shaped by your feedback, and we're excited to kick off 2025 with two new updates: 3 minute reels, and Edits, a powerful new app for making videos on your phone.

Here's a look back at all the latest changes and how you can make the most of them in your reels.

### Tell richer stories with new editing tools & longer reels

Creativity is what makes reels so much fun to watch and create. Over the past year, we’ve made improvements to help you bring your ideas to life and express yourself in even more ways.

- **Get creative with Edits (coming soon).** We’ve heard that creators want more comprehensive editing tools for short-form video creation, all in one place. In the coming weeks, we’re [introducing](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DFBIzLAynIQ/?igsh=aWE3dTV1ZHU4dWxj) Edits, a new video creation app by Instagram to help you make videos you’re proud to share. Edits will offer a full suite of creative tools that will simplify the creation process and help you find inspiration while offering more advanced editing, auto-enhance features and effects, overlays and transitions - and allow you to export without a watermark. It will also include real-time insights to help inform your content strategy. Pre-order Edits [here](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/edits-an-instagram-app/id6738967378).
- **Tell longer stories.** 90 seconds isn’t always enough time to tell a story just the way you want. Starting today, we’re letting creators in the United States publish reels up to 3 minutes long in the Reels editor. Previously, only reels up to 90 seconds were eligible for recommendation, but now reels up to 3 minutes will be eligible to be seen by non-followers in places like the Reels tab and Explore. Appetite around long-form content is changing, and we’ll continue to improve how reels are recommended on Instagram.
- **Edit and customize your reels with ease.** This year, we rolled out [simplified text tools](https://creators.instagram.com/blog/new-text-tools-to-help-you-personalize-your-content), including new fonts, animations and effects to let you customize your content in more ways. On top of that, we also added audio layering, giving you the ability to [add multiple audio tracks to a single reel](https://www.instagram.com/p/C9fcNV2xsGm/?img_index=1). Any unique audio mix you make is attributed to you, which other users can then save and remix.

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=1018199226993006&version=1780930759&transcode_extension=webp)

### Grow your community without the pressure to be perfect

As your follower count rises, so can the pressure to constantly deliver. But creativity doesn't always thrive under those conditions, and the last thing you want is to feel stuck. That's why we’ve introduced new features that encourage experimentation without the stress.

- **Share reels with only people who don’t follow you yet.** Ever had a great idea for a reel but hesitated to post it because you weren't sure how your followers would react? [Trial reels](https://creators.instagram.com/blog/instagram-trial-reels) allow you put those worries aside by giving you a way to share your content with people who don’t follow you first. Explore different content types or editing styles, and if you’re satisfied with the results, you can choose to share the reel with your followers, too!
- **Expand your reach by adding audio.** Now, when you add audio to photos and carousels, they may also appear in the Reels tab. Taking advantage of audio is an easy way to get in front of new audiences.
- **Discover what your friends and followers are into.** Now, we’re making it easier to see and engage with the content your friends adding notes to or are liking on reels at the top of the Reels tab. They’ll also see a reply bar, so people can easily start conversations around content they’re enjoying. For creators, this means even more opportunities for their reels to be seen by people who don’t yet follow you.

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=3872771526298277&version=1780930759&transcode_extension=webp)

### Achieve your goals, whatever they may be

Every creator has a different vision of success. Whether you’re looking to get your name out there, build a business, or simply have fun pushing your creativity, Instagram is here to help you set your goals and then go after them.

- **Make the most of recommendations.** Content ranking on Instagram historically favored creators with larger followings. However, last year we announced [updates to our recommendations of reels](https://creators.instagram.com/recommendations-and-originality?locale=en_US). Through this process, creators of all sizes have an equal chance of breaking through and reaching new audiences. One of the most effective ways to grow is to post original content consistently, because now everyone has the potential to reach a massive audience.
- **Take advantage of best practices.** We recently introduced [best practices](https://creators.instagram.com/blog/best-practices-for-creators), our new in-app destination full of personalized tips and educational reels to help you grow on Instagram.

![](https://lookaside.fbsbx.com/elementpath/media/?media_id=1658354454773358&version=1780930759&transcode_extension=webp)

## **Tips for Improving Your Reach**
- ✅ **Create engaging content.** This includes content you created yourself or content that hasn’t been posted on Instagram before. There are a variety of formats for you to consider when making content: video, photos, and text. However you want to create, we have a format for you. Pro tip: Keep your reels short. In order to be recommended, they must be 3 minutes or less.
- ✅ **Collaborate with other creators.** If you’re working with another creator, use our [Collabs](https://www.facebook.com/help/instagram/291200585956732) feature to create a single post that is shared to both of your followers or use [Enhanced Tags](https://creators.instagram.com/blog/instagram-enhanced-tags-creator-credits-announcement) to include their public and self-identified profile category. These posts can be recommended in places like the Reels tab, Explore, and Feed.
- ✅ **Get discovered via Search.** Followers and non-followers can find you when they search for things on Instagram. Making sure you include relevant keywords in your content, your caption, your bio, and your hashtags.
- **✅ Use the Favorites feature.** We’ve added features and controls like Close Friends, Favorites and Following so fans can further customize their experience. Encourage your top fans to add you to their Favorites - that way, your content will [show up higher in their feeds](https://help.instagram.com/664109784733070/?cms_platform=iphone-app&helpref=platform_switcher).
- ✅ **Monitor your insights.** Check your insights to monitor trends and content performance. Within insights, you can break down Accounts Reached by followers and non-followers so you can see how much of your reach is coming from people who don’t already follow you—and track that over time by changing the time frame selected. Look for patterns and keep tabs on which pieces of content are getting more reach to help inform your content strategy.
- ✅ **Check your Account Status.** See if your account or your account’s content is eligible to be recommended to non-followers in [Account Status](https://creators.instagram.com/micro_site/url/?click_creative_path[0]=link&click_from_context_menu=true&country=US&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.instagram.com%2F%3Fhelpref%3Drelated_articles&event_type=click&last_nav_impression_id=0HfN8L1aRsewRumYr&max_percent_page_viewed=94&max_viewport_height_px=984&max_viewport_width_px=1792&orig_http_referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog&orig_request_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog%2Finstagram-recommendations-eligibility-tips-creators&primary_cmsid=596623488685003&primary_content_locale=en_US&region=noam&scrolled=true&session_id=0GnChEz0rzH35K8bg&site=igc). If you see that you’re not eligible to be recommended, you can understand which content or components of your profile may violate [Community Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119) or [Recommendation Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/313829416281232). Then you can fix it by editing or deleting content; or request our review team take another look.
- ✅ **Post original content, avoid reposted content.** As we recommend more content on Instagram, it’s important the credit, distribution, growth, and monetization go to the original creator, and we’re continuing to work towards this. We’re less likely to recommend reposts of a reel that’s already on Instagram, content with noticeable watermarks, or accounts that regularly collect and reshare others’ content on their feed. Pro tip: Use the [Remix tool](https://www.instagram.com/p/CnkIQWkgJt3/) instead to add your own spin to a popular reel.

For more details on recommendations and tips for improving your reach, [download](https://creators.instagram.com/micro_site/url/?click_creative_path[0]=cta_link&ums_creative_detail=download_pdf_recommendationsHandbook_link&click_from_context_menu=true&country=US&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fbusiness%2Furl%2F%3Fhref%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Ffacebook.com%252Fbusiness%252Ff%252F800798771104394%26cmsid%3D596623488685003%26creative%3Dcta_link%26creative_detail%3Ddownload_pdf_recommendationsHandbook_link%26create_type%3Ddownload%26destination_cms_id%26orig_http_referrer%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fcreators.instagram.com%252Fblog%26search_session_id&event_type=click&last_nav_impression_id=0HfN8L1aRsewRumYr&max_percent_page_viewed=94&max_viewport_height_px=984&max_viewport_width_px=1792&orig_http_referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog&orig_request_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fcreators.instagram.com%2Fblog%2Finstagram-recommendations-eligibility-tips-creators&primary_cmsid=596623488685003&primary_content_locale=en_US&region=noam&scrolled=true&session_id=0GnChEz0rzH35K8bg&site=igc&extra_data[create_type]=download&extra_data[create_type_detail]=&extra_data[target]=https%3A%2F%2Ffacebook.com%2Fbusiness%2Ff%2F800798771104394&extra_data[creative_detail]=download_pdf_recommendationsHandbook_link) our latest recommendations handbook.

Pro tip: Use the [Remix tool](https://www.instagram.com/p/CnkIQWkgJt3/) instead to add your own spin to a popular reel.

**How to Stay Recommendable**

**Follow our** [Recommendation Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/313829416281232) **and** [Community Guidelines](https://help.instagram.com/477434105621119) **.** Content that goes against our Recommendation Guidelines can still be distributed to your followers in Feed and Stories, but we try not to recommend it to non-followers in Explore, Search, Reels, and any other places where we recommend content. While Recommendation Guidelines only govern what we avoid recommending to non-followers, our Community Guidelines apply to all content on Instagram. We remove content that violates our Community Guidelines, and repeatedly posting this kind of content can result in your entire account being disabled.
